result.cache_policy: OS cache reused; freshly created outputs; no cold-cache claim
result.retention: Large generated inputs/outputs removed only after full validation and SHA-256; compact reports retained
result.compression_policy: Rust miniz level 1; native gmsstrm.cpp uses zlib compress() default level 6; compressed throughput is an option/size tradeoff, not equal-level codec parity
result.durability: Rust finalization includes sync_all; native gdxClose durability is not claimed equivalent

initial_probe.scope: single 100000-row/label investigative observations; not repeated performance qualification

findings.disposition: Checked fixed 126-byte packet; native key-byte, semantic and fault gates remain enabled.
Reuse the existing 32 KiB journal buffer as a fixed page, retaining checksums/snapshot checks and no extra minimum-budget capacity.

findings.finding: Initial extra page allocation broke an existing compressed one-MiB probe
findings.disposition: Buffer reuse fixes the admission regression; the original cap/fixture is retained and full writer-check passes.

findings.finding: Windows NTFS last-write timestamp did not reliably expose callback ordinal corruption
findings.disposition: Reproduced unchanged regression returning Ok instead of InvalidSpill; physical checksummed 19-byte ordinal reads and write-through patches on Windows fix it. No test skipped or weakened.

findings.finding: Small bounded bulk registration remains slower than eager native registration
findings.disposition: Measured and reported as a remaining performance limit; external sorting/checksummed disk state trades throughput for a fixed root. Raw record target is separately met; no global metadata throughput parity claim.

findings.finding: Native eager reference metadata cannot use the Rust 512 MiB envelope on oversized dictionaries
findings.disposition: Reference-only metadata validator cap is separately 16 GiB, with actual RSS reported. Every Rust writer and validator remains at enforced 512 MiB; complete reference IDs/digests are mandatory.

findings.finding: Initial exploratory scale run ended after source changes
findings.disposition: Not used for qualification; final clean-source scale and all gates rerun at cc972bf.
Retain first/release test logs and annotate their final 3500 bytes, within the 4096-character API limit; test assertions and matrix remain enabled.

review.role: implementing agent self-review; no independent signoff claimed
review.disposition: M3 sorted-writer exit gate passes on the measured scope; M4 general-input/append/semantic work remains

limits: Linux-only OS/RSS/throughput qualification; native Rust functionality separately passes four platforms.
Three alternating repetitions on 1M records / 250000 labels, shared cloud host with OS cache reused; no cold-cache or all-workload parity claim.
Rust miniz level 1 and native zlib default level 6; compressed timing is a size/option tradeoff. Rust finish sync_all differs from native close durability.
Bounded bulk metadata registration is slower; incremental metadata/reference scans may be quadratic.
Allocation counts not instrumented; tracked capacities, process RSS and actual OS limits are reported.
M2 scale evidence remains task 016; unchanged reader/selection code retains that scope, with fresh reader/label-page gates and new oversized full validators/pipeline here.
No append, general unsorted/string/mapped record adapters, C ABI, parallel writer or Polars integration.
